item.title: Should you be afraid of Elon Musk?
item.description: "Explore the provocative world of Elon Musk in our latest podcast episode, 'Should you be afraid of Elon Musk?' Dive into the Tesla CEO's innovative ventures, controversies, and vision for the future. Tune in to discover the fascinating and sometimes unsettling truth about one of the world's most influential figures." (155 characters, including spaces, for optimal SEO)
